procurementAssistant.missingSellerFacingHash: This screen did not receive the verification token for the inquiry content, so the server will reject any accept request. Go back to the inquiry flow and reload.
procurementAssistant.priceConfirmedNext: Price confirmed. Next, confirm who it goes to
procurementAssistant.recipientsNotFixed: Invited sellers are fixed only when the inquiry is officially published.
procurementAssistant.snapshotApprovalHint: After you confirm, this version of the requirements and target range is used to prepare publication approval.
procurementAssistant.demoFlag: The buyer half is real: the requirement, the recipient list, and the offer range are all sent to the server for a price preview. The seller half is local state; nothing is sent and nobody is notified.
procurementAssistant.demoFinalizeFailed: Could not finalize. The requirement version has most likely changed. Refresh and try again.
procurementAssistant.demoPriceHelp: The ideal price is the unit price you want to close at; the acceptable range is how far you are willing to give. When you finalize, the range is sent to the server for a price preview, which writes no data.
procurementAssistant.demoBoundary: Pressing this only runs the price preview. It writes no data and notifies no seller. Publishing an inquiry is a publication-approval matter and this demo does not call it.
